description: Source code for Odoo process management module, defining classes and methods for process workflows, nodes, transitions, and conditions.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: Custom environment class providing context for object and user.

classes.name: process_process
classes.description: Represents a process workflow with methods for searching and graph visualization.

classes.name: process_node
classes.description: Defines nodes within a process, including copying data functionality.

classes.name: process_node_condition
classes.description: Represents conditions associated with process nodes.

classes.name: process_transition
classes.description: Defines transitions between process nodes, including roles and actions.

classes.name: process_transition_action
classes.description: Specifies actions associated with process transitions.

methods.name: search_by_model
methods.description: Searches for processes related to a specific model.

methods.name: graph_get
methods.description: Generates a graphical representation of a process, including nodes and transitions.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Deep copies a process, including its nodes and transitions.

methods.name: copy_data
methods.description: Copies process node data, resetting transitions.
